title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids (e.g., Electric Kettles, Water Boilers)
mandatory_order: Quality Control Order (QCO) for Electrical Appliances
scope: Covers safety of electric kettles, water boilers and appliances which heat liquids for household and similar use with rated voltage not exceeding 250 V.

clauses.heading: Protection against access to live parts
clauses.text: Appliances shall be constructed and enclosed so that there is adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts during normal use and cleaning.
clauses.test_method: Standard test finger B of IS 1401 applied with a force of 50 N.

clauses.heading: Power input and current verification
clauses.text: The power input at normal operating temperature shall not deviate from the rated power input by more than +5% or -10% for rated inputs > 200W.
clauses.test_method: Wattmeter measurement at 1.06 times rated voltage under boiling conditions.

clauses.heading: Leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature
clauses.text: Leakage current shall not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances. Electric strength test voltage of 1000 V AC applied for 1 min between live parts and accessible metal parts.
clauses.test_method: High voltage breakdown tester applying 1000V/1500V 50Hz for 60s.

clauses.heading: Abnormal operation and boil-dry safety
clauses.text: Kettles must incorporate a thermal cutout to prevent hazardous temperatures and fire hazard if switched on without water or when boiling dry.
clauses.test_method: Boil-dry endurance test run for 100 cycles without liquid.

clauses.heading: Construction and Cordless Base Connection
clauses.text: For cordless kettles, contacts in the base must not become live when kettle is detached, and must withstand 10,000 insertions.
clauses.test_method: Mechanical endurance cycling test at 10 cycles/min.

clauses.heading: Clearances, creepage distances and solid insulation
clauses.text: Creepage distance across basic insulation shall be >= 3.0 mm for Pollution Degree 2.
clauses.test_method: Vernier caliper / micrometer optical measurement.

requirements.name: Boil-dry thermal safety cutout
Dielectric insulation strength (1000V)
Food-grade internal contact material (SS 304 / BPA-free plastic)
Earthing continuity and ground resistance < 0.1 ohm
ISI Mark, Rated Voltage, Power, and Manufacturer Marking

tests.name: Cordless Base Contact Cycling Test (10,000 cycles)

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scheme: Scheme I (Mandatory ISI Mark Certification - FSSAI & BIS Joint Regulatory Mandate)
mandatory_order: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations / BIS Act
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water other than packaged natural mineral water.

clauses.heading: Treatment and Processing Methods
clauses.text: Water shall be derived from any source and subjected to treatments like decantation, filtration, aeration, RO, demineralization, remineralization and disinfection (UV / Ozonation).
clauses.test_method: Plant inspection and process flow audit.

clauses.heading: Organoleptic and Physical Parameters
clauses.text: Colour: Max 2 Hazen units; Turbidity: Max 2 NTU; Odour: Agreeable; Taste: Agreeable; TDS: 75 to 500 mg/L; pH: 6.5 to 8.5.
clauses.test_method: Turbidimeter, Spectrophotometer, and pH meter testing.

clauses.heading: Chemical & Toxic Substance Limits
clauses.text: Lead (Pb) max 0.01 mg/L; Arsenic (As) max 0.01 mg/L; Mercury (Hg) max 0.001 mg/L; Nitrate max 45 mg/L; Fluoride max 1.0 mg/L; Pesticide residues below detectable limit (0.0001 mg/L).
clauses.test_method: ICP-MS, AAS, and GC-MS/MS testing.

clauses.heading: Microbiological Requirements
clauses.text: Total Coliforms: Absent in 250 mL; E. coli: Absent in 250 mL; Faecal Streptococci: Absent in 250 mL; Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Absent in 250 mL; Yeast and Mould: Absent in 250 mL.
clauses.test_method: Membrane filtration and incubation on selective media.

requirements.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) between 75 and 500 mg/L
Zero Microbiological Contamination in 250 mL sample
In-house Testing Laboratory with Microbiologist and Chemist
Tamper-evident food grade PET/Glass packaging container complying with IS 15410

tests.name: Physical and Chemical Parameters (pH, TDS, Hardness)

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Cells/Batteries (Lithium Systems)
scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries containing non-acid electrolyte, under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.

clauses.heading: Continuous charging at constant voltage
clauses.text: A fully charged cell/battery is subjected to continuous charging at manufacturer specified voltage for 7 days without fire or explosion.
clauses.test_method: Constant voltage charging chamber test.

clauses.heading: External short circuit test
clauses.text: Cell or battery is short-circuited by connecting positive and negative terminals with total resistance < 80 mOhm at 20°C and 55°C. No fire, no explosion.
clauses.test_method: Automated short circuit current tester.

clauses.heading: Free fall test
clauses.text: Each fully charged cell/battery is dropped 3 times from height of 1.0 m onto a concrete floor without fire or explosion.
clauses.test_method: Pneumatic drop test apparatus.

clauses.heading: Crush test for cells
clauses.text: Cell is crushed between two flat surfaces with hydraulic force of 13 kN +/- 0.78 kN. No fire or explosion.
clauses.test_method: Hydraulic crush testing machine with load cell.

requirements.name: Protection against external short circuit
Overcharge and over-discharge electronic protection circuit (BMS)
Thermal shock resistance (-20°C to +75°C)
CRS Standard Mark with R-Number display

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Motor Vehicle Riders - Specification
mandatory_order: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) Mandatory QCO
scope: Prescribes requirements regarding materials, construction, finish, mass and performance of protective helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

clauses.heading: General and Ergonomic Requirements
clauses.text: Total mass of the helmet with all accessories shall not exceed 1.2 kg (1200 g). Helmets must provide unobstructed peripheral vision of >= 105 degrees.
clauses.test_method: Mass balance and peripheral visual field fixture.

clauses.heading: Impact Absorption Test
clauses.text: Peak headform acceleration shall not exceed 300 g (2940 m/s^2), and head acceleration exceeding 150 g shall not exceed 5 ms duration when dropped onto flat/kerbstone anvil.
clauses.test_method: Monorail drop tower with triaxial accelerometer headform.

clauses.heading: Retention System (Chin Strap) Dynamic Strength
clauses.text: Dynamic displacement shall not exceed 35 mm and residual displacement after release shall not exceed 25 mm under 10 kg drop weight.
clauses.test_method: Drop hammer retention apparatus.

requirements.name: Maximum helmet weight limit <= 1.2 kg
Shock absorption head acceleration < 300 g
Retention strap elongation < 35 mm under load
Permanent ISI Mark embossing with License CM/L number

tests.name: Impact Attenuation Test (Ambient, Heat, Cold, Water conditioning)

title: Safety of Toys - Mechanical, Flammability, Migration of Elements and Electrical Safety
scheme: Scheme I (Mandatory ISI Mark Certification for Domestic and Foreign Manufacturers)
scope: Covers safety aspects of toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age including physical hazards, flammability, heavy metals toxicity, and phthalates.

clauses.heading: Small parts hazard for children under 36 months
clauses.text: Toys and removable components shall not fit entirely inside the small parts cylinder (31.7 mm diameter x 57.1 mm depth) to prevent choking.
clauses.test_method: Small parts test fixture cylinder.

clauses.heading: Migration of Certain Toxic Elements
clauses.text: Maximum element migration limits (mg/kg): Lead (Pb) <= 90; Cadmium (Cd) <= 75; Mercury (Hg) <= 60; Arsenic (As) <= 25; Antimony (Sb) <= 60; Barium (Ba) <= 1000.
clauses.test_method: Acid extraction and ICP-OES measurement.

clauses.heading: Flammability of plush and costume toys
clauses.text: Rate of flame spread shall not exceed 30 mm/s or flame must self-extinguish before reaching indicator line.
clauses.test_method: Flammability combustion chamber with butane burner.

requirements.name: Choking prevention & Small parts compliance
Heavy metals migration within prescribed threshold (Pb < 90 mg/kg)
Phthalates content <= 0.1% by mass
Factory audit and valid BIS Scheme I License before market entry

tests.name: Torque and Tension Test for Small Detachable Parts

title: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval (Solar Panels)
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) - Scheme II (MNRE Order)
mandatory_order: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order
scope: Lays down requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial PV modules suitable for long-term operation in open-air climates.

clauses.heading: Thermal cycling test (200 cycles from -40°C to +85°C)
clauses.text: Module is subjected to 200 thermal cycles with peak current injection. Power degradation shall be < 5% with no dielectric breakdown.
clauses.test_method: Climatic thermal cycling chamber.

clauses.heading: Damp heat test (1000 hours at 85°C and 85% RH)
clauses.text: Continuous environmental stress test without delamination, yellowing or power loss > 5%.
clauses.test_method: Environmental humidity-temperature chamber.

clauses.heading: Mechanical load test (Snow & Wind resistance)
clauses.text: Static mechanical load of 2400 Pa (wind) and 5400 Pa (snow) applied uniformly for 3 cycles of 1 hour.
clauses.test_method: Pneumatic/hydraulic surface load frame.

requirements.name: Maximum power degradation < 5% post environmental endurance
Wet leakage current insulation resistance > 40 MΩ·m²
ALMM (Approved List of Models and Manufacturers) listing + BIS CRS Registration

tests.name: Flash Simulator STC Maximum Power Determination

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements for domestic pressure cookers made of aluminium alloys or stainless steel with capacity up to 20 litres.

clauses.heading: Safety Devices and Operating Pressure
clauses.text: Operating pressure shall be 1.0 kgf/cm² (98 kPa). Cooker must be fitted with at least one secondary safety device (fusible plug / GRS) releasing before 3.0 kgf/cm².
clauses.test_method: Hydraulic pressure testing rig.

clauses.heading: Proof Pressure and Bursting Pressure Test
clauses.text: Cooker body and lid must withstand hydrostatic proof pressure of 2.0 kgf/cm² for 2 minutes without leakage or permanent deformation.
clauses.test_method: Water pressure pump with calibrated digital manometer.

requirements.name: Secondary safety device (Fusible Alloy Plug / GRS System)
Hydrostatic proof pressure test at 2.0 kgf/cm²
Food contact material compliance (Alloy Grade / SS 304)

tests.name: Proof Pressure Hydrostatic Test (2x Operating Pressure)

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking (Hallmarking)
scheme: Mandatory Gold Hallmarking Scheme with HUID (6-digit alphanumeric)
mandatory_order: Department of Consumer Affairs Mandatory Hallmarking Order
scope: Prescribes purity standards, assaying methods, and hallmarking requirements for gold jewellery and artefacts.

clauses.heading: Recognized Caratage and Fineness Grades
clauses.test_method: Fire Assay (Cupellation) conforming to IS 1418 or XRF screening.

clauses.heading: Hallmarking Marks Composition
clauses.text: 3 mandatory marks: 1. BIS Logo (Triangle), 2. Purity in Karat & Fineness (e.g., 22K916), 3. Unique 6-digit alphanumeric HUID stamped by BIS Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC).
clauses.test_method: Laser inscription by BIS AHC portal integration.

requirements.name: Registration of Jeweller on Manakonline portal
Assaying at BIS-recognized AHC via Fire Assay IS 1418
6-digit HUID verification on BIS CARE App
